loading.title: Loading...
loading.hint: Digivice will be ready to use in a moment!

sidecarCrashed.title: Oops! It looks like the Memory Reader is not running...
sidecarCrashed.hint: It would be really kind of you to send a screenshot of this failure to the developer :)

hubUnreachable.title: Oops! The Memory Reader is running, but it can't communicate...
hubUnreachable.hint: It would be really kind of you to send a screenshot of this failure to the developer :)

emulator.title: Oops! Something went wrong during the memory reading process...
emulator.hint: It would be really kind of you to send a screenshot of this failure to the developer :)

config_missing.title: Emulator configuration missing
config_missing.hint: The app could not find EmulatorProcessName in the backend settings.

process_not_found.title: Is your DuckStation open?
process_not_found.hint: Digivice could not find a running emulator. Make sure DuckStation is running, and under Debugging enable Shared memory export.

mapping_not_found.title: Memory export unavailable
mapping_not_found.hint: In DuckStation, open Debugging, enable Export Memory Shared, then reload the game.

connection_failed.title: Could not connect to DuckStation memory
connection_failed.hint: The app found DuckStation but failed to open the shared memory mapping. See the technical detail below.

memory_read_failed.title: Failed to read emulator memory
memory_read_failed.hint: The connection was lost while reading game data. See the technical detail below.

state_compose_failed.title: Failed to process game state
state_compose_failed.hint: The app connected to DuckStation but could not build the current game state. See the technical detail below.
